core_philosophy: Ultra-conservative income-generating portfolio anchored in short-term Treasuries with supplemental yield from covered-call equity income and dividend equities. Designed for capital preservation and reliable cash flow.
behavioral_commitment: This is the safety net — never compromise its conservative allocation for higher returns. Let SGOV do its job as the bedrock. Rebalance mechanically on schedule.

intentional_overlap.JEPI_and_SCHD: JEPI and SCHD overlap in large-cap U.S. dividend equities. Intentional to blend active covered-call income generation with passive dividend quality.

target_allocation.name: iShares 0-3 Month Treasury Bond ETF
target_allocation.role: Ultra-short Treasury — capital preservation and near-cash yield

notes: Taxable account — be mindful of dividend and capital gains tax implications.
SGOV distributions taxed as ordinary income at federal level, exempt from state tax.
JEPI generates monthly income but distributions are a mix of ordinary income and return of capital.
SCHD dividends qualify for favorable qualified dividend tax treatment.
60% SGOV allocation reflects ultra-conservative income-first mandate.
